title: Gato Verde Adventure Sailing
specs: First wind electric hybrid charter boat on the West Coast
Silent electric motors for whale watching with hydrophone to listen underwater
Maximum group size is 6 passengers for all charters
includes: Use of a 42 foot long catamaran with wind electric hybrid propulsion
blurb: Guests can enjoy customized boat tours, wildlife viewing, sailing instruction, or skippered sailing charters ranging from 1.5 to 8 hours. Sailing charters are limited to six passengers and offer hands-on experience and instruction tailored to guests' skills and desires. The business emphasizes environmental stewardship and sustainable development.
extraNote: No overnight charters available for 2025 due to Coast Guard regulations · Guests may bring their own food and beverages · Bellingham Cruise Terminal in Historic Fairhaven · Open day trips daily June 1 - Sept 15; weekends April 15-May 30 and Sept 15-Oct 30; open sunset cruises daily June 1 - Sept 15; weekends April 15-May 30 and Sept 15-Oct 30
